name: csharp-event-type-plain-id
description: A new public event uses plain [EventType] even when a repository spec says every public event pins a UUID and no decision record backs it; the existing pinned event keeps its id. Patterns are JS-compatible .NET regex and ignore declarations that follow a // or /* on the same line.
prompt: Add the new public event AuthorRegistered and a RegisterAuthor command that appends it, in Source/Authors/Registration.cs. Follow docs/specs/events.md where it applies. Write the code to files.
expected_output: AuthorRegistered carries a plain [EventType]; AuthorImported keeps its original pinned id.
